What I Make

Every piece is designed and printed to order. Send a photo or an idea — I turn it into something you can hold.

🎁 Personalized Gifts

Busts, plaques, figurines, and keepsakes made from your photos — birthdays, anniversaries, and just-because gifts.

🏠 Home Decor

Photo lamps, sculptures, and one-of-a-kind pieces designed for your space.

💍 Keychains & Bracelets

Small, giftable prints — heart keychains, braided bracelets, and custom charms.

🛠️ Prototypes & Parts

Broken part? Don't toss it. Custom replacement parts and prototypes, including carbon fiber reinforced options.

How to Order

1

Send your photo

DM me on Instagram with the photo or idea you want printed.

2

Tell me the details

Product type, size, colors, the date you need it, and shipping or pickup.

3

Get your exact quote

Once I see the photo, I'll send your exact price and timing — no guessing.

4

I design & print it

Your piece is designed, printed, and finished — then it's on its way to you.

📋 To get your quote fastest, include:
  • The photo you want printed
  • What you'd like — bust, plaque, lamp, keepsake, or something else
  • Size and colors
  • The date you need it by
  • Shipping or pickup

Scan to order

Point your camera at the code to open @thinkin3d_1099 on Instagram — then send a DM with your photo to start your order.

Open Instagram

Questions

How much does it cost?

It depends on the size and detail of your piece. Send your photo in a DM and I'll give you an exact price and timing before you commit.

What can you make from a photo?

Busts, plaques, lamps, figurines, and keepsakes. If you have something else in mind, send it — I'll tell you honestly if it can be printed.

How do I start?

DM @thinkin3d_1099 on Instagram with your photo, what you'd like made, size, colors, the date you need it, and whether you want shipping or pickup.
